concerns.text: The plan validates fork‑point genes against a therapy‑response gene set sourced from a Hugging Face JSON file (https://huggingface.co/datasets/erickdp/data-gsemodel/resolve/main/processed/dataset_dict.json). This source is not a peer‑reviewed, independently published signature and therefore does not satisfy FR‑008’s requirement for an *independent published therapy‑response signature* (e.g., a PMID‑referenced study). Using an unverified dataset risks violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and undermines the scientific validity of the enrichment validation.

The power analysis is specified to run 10 000 Monte‑Carlo simulations (effect size d = 0.5, α = 0.05). Executing 10 k simulations on the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ~7 GB RAM, ≤6 h) is unlikely to complete within the allotted time and memory budget, making the compute plan infeasible under the platform’s free‑compute constraints.
